entries.subject: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94
entries.finding: Every galaxy between 3 and 200 Mpc is drawn at its CF4 distance modulus (all methods); no Hubble-law distance is used. Thinned to an even density per nested level (source/galaxies-*/merge.json).

entries.subject: Paturel et al. (2003), HYPERLEDA I, A&A 412, 45
entries.finding: The 2003 PGC's morphology strings cover a quarter of CF4's galaxies (14,131 of 55,877); the current HyperLEDA's numerical type T covers 97%.

entries.subject: Paturel et al. (2003), HYPERLEDA II, A&A 412, 57
entries.finding: HI velocities gave Hubble-law distances to galaxies without a measured one; the field now draws only CF4's measured distances.

entries.subject: Layered XYZ galaxy point bake
entries.finding: Rejected during development because point depth quantization and cross-axis transitions reduced point sharpness. Current renderer batches projected catalogue points and uses separate covariance count clouds. This consolidates the recorded implementation decision, not a new benchmark.
entries.revisitWhen: A matched rotation benchmark demonstrates sharper stable points at the same bounded rendering cost.

entries.subject: HyperLEDA numerical morphological type T (Makarov et al. 2014)
entries.finding: T for 25,877 of the 27,277 galaxies, queried from the HyperLEDA mirror on 2026-09-29 and joined by PGC; it picks each galaxy's template colour.

entries.subject: Kinney et al. (1996) galaxy template spectra
entries.finding: The E, S0, Sa, Sb and Sc templates through the CIE 1931 observer give the type colours. HyperLEDA's measured B-V (bvtc) was tried first and is empty for most CF4 galaxies.

entries.subject: Authored galaxy-count clouds, brightness and morphology tints
entries.finding: The 160 fitted clouds, the brightness formula without photometry and the hand-picked morphology colours were replaced by even-density dots in template colours; none of them was a measurement.
